{{CharInfobox |color={{dark color}} |corecolor={{kalos color light}} |bordercolor={{kalos color dark}} |name=Kidd Summers |jname=キッド・サマーズ |tmname=Kid Summers |slogan=no |image=Kidd Summers.png |size=150px |caption=Kidd Summers |gender=Female |colors=yes |eyes=Blue |hair=Dark Brown |hometown=Unknown |region=Unknown |relatives=Unknown |trainer=no |game=no |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=M08 |epname=Lucario and the Mystery of Mew |enva=[[Rebecca Soler]] |java=[[Becky]] }} '''Kidd Summers''' (Japanese: '''キッド・サマーズ''' ''Kid Summers'') is a major character who appeared in ''[[M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew]]''. She is a multi-record-breaking adventurer who works for a mysterious organization run by her commander, [[Banks|Lieutenant Banks]]. ==In the movies== Kidd first appeared at [[Cameran Palace]] taking part in the town of [[Rota]]'s annual [[Aura Guardian Festival]] tournament to decide the "Hero of the Year", dressed in a traditional knight's armor. She and one of her {{p|Weavile}} lost in the final round to {{Ash}} and his {{AP|Pikachu}}, where she revealed herself as a woman. After dancing with {{an|Brock}} at the ceremonial ball, she slipped away, changing into her normal outfit to research the connection between {{OBP|Mew|M08}} and the [[Tree of Beginning]]. From the roof of the palace, she sent her two Weavile to place a tracking device on Mew, but they both failed due to the efforts of Ash and {{an|May}}'s Pokémon. She later met up with Ash and {{ashfr}} to try and find {{AP|Pikachu}}, with the help of {{OBP|Lucario|M08}}, after Mew took him and {{MTR}} to the [[Tree of Beginning]]. Throughout her journey, Kidd often kept in contact with her commander, [[Banks|Lieutenant Banks]], transmitting information about Mew, Lucario, and the Tree of Beginning to him. She was attacked by the red blob "antibodies" produced by the Tree of Beginning to keep humans away, being captured and "eaten" by one, after sending out her Weavile to keep them safe. However, she was quickly brought back thanks to Mew. She also helped Mew after it fell ill, due to the gradual destruction of the Tree of Beginning. After Mew and the Tree were saved, Banks told Kidd that she would make a fortune from selling the story of her adventure, but she turned it down to keep the Tree safe. During the credits, she was seen waving goodbye to Ash and his friends as they returned on their {{pkmn|journey}}. She was last seen visiting [[Forina]] alongside [[Butler]] and [[Diane]]. Kidd later briefly reappeared in a montage in ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]'', which chronicled the preceding nine {{pkmn|movie}}s. ===Character=== [[File:Kidd Summers photos.png|thumb|250px|Photos of some of Kidd Summers' records]] Kidd Summers is a celebrity and renowned for her many adventurous feats. She has a world record for holding the most world records. Some of these records include a record for making the quickest trip around the world in a hot-air balloon, deepest one-man submarine dive, and longest independent space walk. Even so, she remained mysterious throughout her appearance, and was initially mistaken as a villain while she was after {{OBP|Mew|M08}} for research purposes. While her Pokémon failed to aid her mission, Kidd cares for her Pokémon very much, as shown when she let her Weavile out to save themselves while being attacked by the red blobs in the [[Tree of Beginning]]. She proved swift and tactical in her approach. Kidd later joined {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} to save [[Ash's Pikachu]], while covertly she was still determined to find Mew at the Tree of Beginning. She changed her thoughts on the matter after learning more about Mew's connection with the Tree of Beginning, which was a pristine ecosystem, informing her commander that she wished to protect it from human exploitation. ===Pokémon=== This listing is of Kidd Summers's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Kidd Summers |pkmn=Weavile (×2) |type1=Dark |type2=Ice |img=Kidd Summers Weavile.png |cap=Kidd's Weavile |epnum=M08 |epname=Lucario and the Mystery of Mew |vajp=Daisuke Sakaguchi |vajp2=List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Jun Fukushima |vaen=Eric Stuart |vaennote=both Weavile |desc=One of the {{p|Weavile}} is first introduced in the tournament being held, where it battles with [[Ash's Pikachu]] in the final round, it first used Shadow Ball and then was ultimately defeated by Pikachu's {{m|Thunderbolt}}. Later, Kidd uses both Weavile in an attempt to place a tracking device on {{mov|Mew|Mew|8}}. Both Weavile are seen again when Kidd is being sucked in by the [[Tree of Beginning]], and they are let out as an attempt to free them. When they realize Kidd is back, they have a happy reunion, showing how much Kidd really loves her Pokémon.
